history.summary: A 99-year 3BR (1,023 sqft) at the One-North MRT doorstep in D05, asking $2.45M ($2,395 psf) under a 'cheap' marketing title that is not actually cheap. The PSF is full new-launch pricing for the One-North area, with no disclosed project, built_year, or URA data to underwrite it.
history.rating_rationale: $2,395 psf at $2.45M is top-of-market for a leasehold One-North 3BR — the 'cheap' label is marketing. The location (literally at One-North MRT, in the One-North/Fusionopolis R&D job belt) is genuinely strong for rental and resale, which is what keeps it off Avoid. But you are paying a full premium PSF with no project name, no built_year and no URA series to verify the appreciation or what you're actually buying. Strong location, unconvincing price/data.
red_flags: $2,395 psf at full new-launch pricing despite 'cheap' title
Missing project name and built_year — cannot verify the development
$2.45M sits at the upper edge of the liquid band
catalysts: At One-North MRT (CCL) — One-North/Fusionopolis/biopolis R&D and tech employment
TEL/One-north connectivity, strong professional tenant base
D05 RCR location with durable rental demand

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: One-North is one of Singapore's strongest professional rental catchments; a 3BR at the MRT door rents well. But entry PSF is high, compressing yield.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: Location supports RCR-class appreciation, but paying full premium PSF at entry limits the margin; base case is RCR-baseline-ish with little discount captured.
